meta.title: STAR HILL Residence — Luxury amid nature, on the slopes of Bogd Uul
meta.description: STAR HILL Residence: a luxury development designed by Aedas on the slopes of Bogd Mountain, Ulaanbaatar. Crystal, Diamond and Penthouse residences of 2–5 rooms and 56.6–212.7 m², a 6,248 m² sports complex and 20,000 m² of landscaped grounds.

intro.label: Star Hill Residence
intro.heading: Luxury in the midst of nature.
intro.lede: Rising on the high ground of Ulaanbaatar, on the slopes of Bogd Khan Mountain, Star Hill Residence looks out over unspoilt nature to the south, west and east — and across the wide panorama of the capital to the north.
intro.body: A space, free from all the worries of the outside world, in which to rediscover your true self.
intro.aside: Khan-Uul District · Eastern foothills of Bogd Mountain

general.label: Overview
general.body: Founded in 2002 by the Welsh architect Keith Griffiths, Aedas is an international architecture practice of more than 1,500 architects, working in over ten countries including the USA, the UK, China, Hong Kong, Singapore, the UAE and Saudi Arabia.

founder.label: Founder
founder.name: Keith Griffiths
founder.role: Founder and chairman of Aedas · architect and urban planner
founder.body: The Welsh architect Keith Griffiths brings deep international experience in architecture and urban planning. He worked in Foster's team in London on the HSBC headquarters in Hong Kong, then broadened his practice through international projects across Asia, Europe, the Americas and the Middle East. Today, as founder and chairman, he leads Aedas's architecture and planning work worldwide.
founder.starHill: Drawing on that experience, he served as lead consultant to Star Hill, advising on the architectural concept, the spatial design and the integrated masterplan. He also helped shape the core design of the five-storey, glass-fronted sports and services complex — the project's modern face and functional plan.

architecture.label: International standard
architecture.heading: World-class architecture by Aedas.
architecture.lede: High on the slopes of Bogd Khan Mountain, windows to the south, west and east frame unspoilt nature, while those facing north hold the whole city in view — so the buildings are wrapped entirely in glass.

sculptural.title: One integrated plan
sculptural.caption: Four buildings on a 9,000+ m² footprint, planned as one.

glass.title: Glass façade

light.title: Floor-to-ceiling windows
light.caption: Daylight and views in every room.

nature.label: Landscape
nature.heading: On the slopes of Bogd Uul.
nature.body: Of a site of more than 40,000 m², just over 9,000 m² is built on. 20,000 m² is given to landscape: tall pine, larch, birch and poplar, shrubs of lilac, bird cherry, spiraea and caragana, and beds of peony, phlox and perennial roses — more than 40 plant species in all.

experience.label: Resident comforts
experience.heading: Everything you need, in one place.

highlights.trail: Walking trail straight up Bogd Mountain
highlights.sports: Sports complex with reflecting pool and usable roof

sports.title: Sports complex
sports.body: A five-storey, glass-fronted 6,248 m² sports and services complex within the grounds: yoga and Pilates studios, a fully equipped gym, a 25-metre five-lane pool, sauna and jacuzzi, a premium restaurant, shops and an open terrace with a reflecting pool.

fitness.title: Fitness centre
fitness.body: A fully equipped 737 m² fitness centre on the complex's ground floor — generous space and modern equipment for a healthy, active life every day.

grounds.title: Landscaped grounds
grounds.body: Gardens that stay green through four seasons, a clear reflecting pool, an open terrace and coffee shop looking over the city, two playgrounds by age group, a basketball court, running and cycle paths and shade pavilions — all in a car-free zone.

concierge.title: Concierge
concierge.body: Guests welcomed with courtesy; residents' security, post and parcels, deliveries, cleaning, repairs and everyday special requests handled in one dedicated service.

values.developer: STAR HILL Residence — a luxury residential development on the high ground of Ulaanbaatar, on the slopes of Bogd Khan Mountain.
values.architect: Aedas (international). Founded by Keith Griffiths in 2002; 1,500+ architects in over ten countries. A&D Awards 2025 Architecture Firm of the Year.
values.location: Khan-Uul District, 11th khoroo, eastern foothills of Bogd Mountain. 6.5 km from the city centre.
values.residences: 2–5 rooms, 56.6–212.7 m², behind floor-to-ceiling glass. Residences, sports complex and landscape planned together across more than 40,000 m².
values.collections: Crystal (56.6–114.4 m² · 2–3 rooms), Diamond (117.8–148 m² · 3–4 rooms, duplex), Penthouse (109.7–212.7 m² · 3–5 rooms).
values.amenities: 6,248 m² sports and services complex (pool, gym, sauna, restaurant), concierge, usable rooftops, an open terrace with coffee shop, 600+ parking spaces, EV charging and 20,000 m² of landscape.
values.brands: Reynaers (Belgium), Hörmann (Germany), Tempini (Italy), ter Hürne (Germany), Kohler (USA), Danfoss (Denmark), Hyundai (Korea), SOLID (Korea).
values.financing: 6% mortgages for residences up to 80 m²; 30% down with long-term loans from Khan Bank, TDB and Golomt at 1.45–1.5% a month; or 30–50% down with interest-free instalments until handover.

residences.label: Residences
residences.heading: Three collections.
residences.intro: Residences of {rooms} rooms and {area}, with floor-to-ceiling windows and fittings from the world's most respected brands.

crystal.subtitle: Crystal collection
crystal.body: Smartly planned 2–3 room residences of 56.6–114.4 m²: large windows that bring in the most daylight, modern interiors and careful detailing that make everyday life finer and more comfortable.

diamond.subtitle: Diamond collection
diamond.body: 3–4 room duplex residences of 117.8–148 m², with generous plans, high ceilings, large windows, luxurious interiors, advanced technology, quality fittings and fine craftsmanship — a home that expresses how you live.

penthouse.subtitle: Penthouse collection
penthouse.body: Expansive rooms, floor-to-ceiling windows and panoramic views across the whole city: Penthouses of 109.7–212.7 m² for the highest comfort and a distinguished way of life.
